name: bb-studio
description: BB Studio: one Studio plugin with pages, recordings, drawings, designs, dashboards, artifacts, Code and Decisions built in, plus Mobile for iOS notifications.

plugins.description: The home of BB Studio, with pages, recordings, drawings, designs, dashboards, mini apps and artifacts built in: one collection with search, tags, project leads, item conversations, quotes, emoji reactions on replies, VS Code on each thread’s worktree, and Decisions for Jev, fallback models and Smart Queue.
Part of BB Studio. The server side of the BB Studio iOS app: push notifications with lock-screen actions and muted threads.
